title: Admin View Vendor Details - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Admin View Vendor Details modal/panel covering WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for modal dialog, business details display, contact information, document viewing, read-only fields, missing document warnings, and focus management.

testCases.title: View Details button keyboard accessible
testCases.componentElement: View Details button on vendor card
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page with vendors displayed
steps: 1. Tab to View Details button on a vendor card
2. Verify focus indicator visible with 3:1 contrast
3. Verify button has accessible name ('View Details' or 'View Details for [Vendor Name]')
4. Press Enter to activate
5. Verify modal/panel opens

testCases.title: Modal/panel has role='dialog' and aria-modal
steps: 1. Open Vendor Details modal
2. Verify modal has role='dialog'
3. Verify aria-modal='true' present
4. Verify modal has accessible name (aria-labelledby or aria-label)
5. Use screen reader to verify dialog announced

testCases.title: Focus moves to modal on open
steps: 1. Click View Details button
2. Verify focus moves into the modal
3. Verify focus lands on modal heading or first interactive element
4. Verify background content not accessible via Tab
expectedResults: Focus moves into modal on open
Focus lands on heading or close button
Background content not reachable via Tab

testCases.title: Focus trapped within modal
steps: 1. Tab through all elements in modal
2. Verify focus cycles within modal (does not escape to background)
3. Verify Shift+Tab cycles in reverse within modal
4. Verify background has aria-hidden='true' or inert
expectedResults: Tab cycles through modal elements only
Background content hidden from assistive tech
WCAG 2.1.2 compliant (trap is intentional for modals)

testCases.title: Escape key closes modal
steps: 1. Press Escape key
2. Verify modal closes
3. Verify focus returns to View Details button that triggered the modal

testCases.title: Close button keyboard accessible
steps: 1. Tab to close button (X icon)
2. Verify focus indicator visible
3. Verify button has accessible name ('Close' or 'Close dialog')
4. Press Enter to close
5. Verify focus returns to trigger button

testCases.title: Modal heading structure proper
testCases.wcagCriterion: 2.4.6 Headings and Labels, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
steps: 1. Verify modal has a heading (H2 or H3)
2. Verify heading includes vendor name
3. Verify section headings for Business Details, Contact, Documents
4. Use screen reader heading navigation within modal
expectedResults: Screen reader can navigate by headings within modal

testCases.title: Business details fields have labels
testCases.componentElement: Business details (category, GST, application date, products listed)
steps: 1. Locate business details section
2. Verify each field has a visible label (Category, GST Number, Application Date, Products Listed)
3. Verify labels programmatically associated with values
4. Use screen reader to verify label-value pairs announced
5. Verify definition list (<dl>) or table structure used
expectedResults: Labels associated with values (dl/dt/dd or aria-labelledby)
Semantic structure used (dl, table, or labeled divs)

testCases.title: Contact information accessible
testCases.preconditions: Vendor Details modal is open with contact info
steps: 1. Locate contact person name — verify label present
2. Locate email — verify it's a mailto: link with descriptive text
3. Locate phone — verify it's a tel: link
4. Locate website — verify it's a link with target='_blank' indication
5. Verify all links keyboard accessible
6. Use screen reader to verify contact announced
expectedResults: Email is mailto: link with accessible name
Phone is tel: link with accessible name
Website link indicates opens in new tab

testCases.title: Address field accessible
steps: 1. Locate address field
2. Verify label 'Address' present
3. Verify address text readable by screen reader
4. Verify address has 4.5:1 contrast
expectedResults: Address text announced by screen reader

testCases.title: Verification documents viewable and accessible
testCases.componentElement: Uploaded verification documents with view option
testCases.preconditions: Vendor Details modal is open with documents uploaded
steps: 1. Locate documents section
2. Verify each document has descriptive name/label
3. Verify 'View' button/link for each document
4. Tab to View button — verify keyboard accessible
5. Verify View button has accessible name ('View [Document Name]')
6. Activate View — verify document opens (new tab or inline)
7. If new tab, verify aria-label indicates 'opens in new tab'
expectedResults: View button has descriptive accessible name
New tab opening indicated in accessible name

testCases.title: Missing documents clearly flagged
testCases.preconditions: Vendor Details modal is open for vendor with missing documents
steps: 1. Open details for vendor with missing documents
2. Verify missing document warning visible
3. Verify warning has text label (not just icon/color)
4. Verify warning announced by screen reader
5. Verify warning has role='alert' or aria-live
6. Verify warning text has 4.5:1 contrast
7. Verify not relying on color alone
expectedResults: Warning has text label (e.g., 'Document not uploaded')
Warning not conveyed by color alone

testCases.title: Invalid document format warning accessible
testCases.preconditions: Vendor has uploaded document in invalid format
steps: 1. Open details for vendor with invalid document
2. Verify warning message displayed
3. Verify warning has role='alert' or aria-live
4. Verify warning announced by screen reader
5. Verify warning text has 4.5:1 contrast

testCases.title: Read-only fields indicated accessibly
testCases.preconditions: Vendor Details modal is open (read-only mode)
steps: 1. Verify all fields are read-only (not editable)
2. Verify fields not in tab order (non-interactive)
3. Verify screen reader announces content as text (not as editable fields)
4. Verify visual styling indicates read-only state
expectedResults: Fields are read-only and not editable
Non-interactive fields not in tab order
Screen reader reads content as static text

testCases.title: Vendor deleted while modal open — graceful close
testCases.componentElement: Graceful close message on vendor deletion
testCases.preconditions: Vendor Details modal is open and vendor is deleted by another admin
steps: 1. Open vendor details modal
2. Simulate vendor deletion (or wait for it)
3. Verify graceful close with message
4. Verify message has role='alert'
5. Verify message announced by screen reader
6. Verify focus returns to vendor list

testCases.title: Modal text contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.componentElement: All text in Vendor Details modal
steps: 1. Measure heading text contrast
2. Measure label text contrast
3. Measure value text contrast
4. Measure warning/error text contrast
5. Measure link text contrast

testCases.title: Modal usable at 200% zoom
steps: 1. Set browser zoom to 200%
2. Verify all modal content visible
3. Verify modal scrollable if content overflows
4. Verify no horizontal scrolling within modal
5. Verify no text truncation

testCases.title: Modal accessible on mobile viewport
steps: 1. Set viewport to mobile (375x667)
2. Open Vendor Details modal
3. Verify modal adapts to viewport
4. Verify all content readable
5. Verify close button touch target at least 44x44px
6. Verify no horizontal scrolling

testCases.title: NVDA screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: NVDA enabled, Admin on Vendor Lists page
steps: 1. Open Vendor Details modal with NVDA
2. Verify dialog announced
3. Navigate headings within modal
4. Verify all field labels and values announced
5. Navigate to documents section
6. Close modal and verify focus return announced

testCases.title: JAWS screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: JAWS enabled, Admin on Vendor Lists page
steps: 1. Open Vendor Details modal with JAWS
2. Verify dialog announced
3. Use virtual cursor within modal
4. Verify all content accessible
5. Activate document view links
6. Close modal and verify focus return

testCases.title: Information not conveyed by color alone
steps: 1. Review all visual indicators in modal
2. Verify missing document warning has text (not just red icon)
3. Verify document status has text label
4. Test in grayscale mode — verify all info distinguishable
5. Verify vendor status has text label
expectedResults: All information conveyed by text, not color alone

testCases.title: Products listed section accessible
testCases.componentElement: Products listed count/list in vendor details
testCases.preconditions: Vendor Details modal is open for vendor with products
steps: 1. Locate 'Products Listed' section
2. Verify label present
3. Verify count or list announced by screen reader
4. If list of products shown, verify semantic list structure
5. Verify product names have 4.5:1 contrast
expectedResults: Count or list announced by screen reader
Semantic list structure if multiple products
